name: @goodandready/dsh-russian-lang
description: Russian localization for DeepSeek Harness (DSH v0.1.5-rc.2+) web UI: adds Русский as native language option. 100.0% coverage across 10,542 keys (116 namespaces). Features hotfix for live typography (issue #198: zero caret jump on contenteditable, native undo, streaming selection preservation), unified dsh-clinebot visual design, One-click plugin updater (/api/dsh-russian-lang/update) with safe Cordis 4 webServer injection, companion plugins, Markdown export, and Alt+L layout corrector.

scripts.check: python3 tools/lint_translations.py && python3 check-coverage.py && python3 tools/term_check.py --ci
scripts.test: node --test test/*.mjs && node test/_repro.cjs && python3 test/test_tools.py && python3 test/test_extract.py && python3 test/test_overflow.py
